articles.summary: Yemen’s Iran-allied Houthi rebels said they launched attacks at Saudi oil facilities and airports on Saturday while Yemen’s Saudi-backed government ​said the ‌group also fired three ballistic missiles at coast guard sites in ⁠the port city of Aden.

articles.title: Yemen’s Houthis say 11 killed in strikes on Sanaa; Saudis say two missiles shot down
Houthis say Saudi strike kills five members of same family in Hodeida
articles.summary: Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis on Saturday said a Saudi strike on Hodeida killed five members of the same family, as both sides carry out attacks. "Five people, the head of the family, two of his children and his two wives, have been martyred and his daughter wounded as a result of a Saudi enemy air strike on the home of citizen Abdulwahed al-Wasabi in the Al-Tuhayta district" of Hodeida, the Houthis' Al-Masirah TV channel reported. Reporting by AFP

articles.title: Three killed in Saudi air strike on Sanaa, says Houthi-linked media
articles.summary: A Saudi airstrike on the Yemeni capital Sanaa killed three people on Saturday and wounded several others, according to Houthi-backed media. Al-Masirah station said "the Saudi enemy targeted a house in Asr," in the west of the capital. It added that the death toll was preliminary.
